report:
## Conclusion

**The claim is well-supported by strong evidence.** The adjuvanted recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV, brand name Shingrix) significantly reduces shingles (herpes zoster) in adults aged 70 years and older, with high efficacy demonstrated in both randomized clinical trials and real-world studies.

### Key Evidence

**1. Pivotal Phase III Trial (ZOE-70):** The ZOE-70 trial, published in the *New England Journal of Medicine* in 2016, randomized 13,900 adults aged ≥70 years (mean age 75.6) to receive either the HZ/su vaccine or placebo. The vaccine significantly reduced the risk of herpes zoster and postherpetic neuralgia in this population, with vaccine efficacy of approximately 90% against confirmed herpes zoster — notably, efficacy in adults ≥70 was similar to that seen in younger adults (≥50). This represented a marked improvement over the older live zoster vaccine.
- Source: https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa1603800

**2. Companion Trial (ZOE-50):** The ZOE-50 trial (NEJM 2015) demonstrated that the vaccine significantly reduced herpes zoster risk in adults ≥50, and efficacy in the ≥70 subgroup was comparable, reinforcing the finding that age does not substantially diminish the vaccine's performance.
- Source: https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa1501184

**3. Long-Term Durability:** An extension study (ZOE-LTFU) following participants from both ZOE-50 and ZOE-70 for up to 11 years post-vaccination found that RZV confers durable protection against herpes zoster for at least a decade, with no significant waning of efficacy.
- Source: https://www.thelancet.com/journals/eclinm/article/PIIS2589-5370(25)00173-7/fulltext

**4. Real-World Effectiveness:** Multiple post-licensure observational studies — including a 2025 target trial emulation using Medicare claims data and a CDC Vaccine Safety Datalink cohort study — have confirmed that real-world effectiveness of RZV in older adults aligns closely with the >90% efficacy seen in clinical trials.
- Source: https://www.med.unc.edu/fammed/2025/10/21/unc-study-confirms-shingles-vaccine-effectiveness-in-older-adults/

### Summary

The evidence is robust and consistent: two large randomized controlled trials, long-term follow-up data extending to ~11 years, and multiple real-world effectiveness studies all confirm that RZV substantially reduces shingles in adults aged ≥70, with efficacy approaching or exceeding 90%.
